refresh_spy_reading: arm a: reads of the sign-in credentials secret 0, sign-in POSTs served by the replay 0, session-secret writes 0, template probes 1 (arm b, a different unauthenticated reason: 1, 1, 1)
challenge_ending_in_words: In withAuthenticatedPage, a stored bundle whose probe reason is WAF_CHALLENGE throws the same ChallengeFailure acquireSession uses (failure class UNEXPECTED_CHALLENGE, record.reason WAF_CHALLENGE, retried false), which the resident forwards as CAPTURE_FAILED:UNEXPECTED_CHALLENGE:WAF_CHALLENGE; refreshSession is never called, so no sign-in, no retry and no wait. Any other unauthenticated reason on a stored bundle (for example NO_IDENTITY_COOKIE) still refreshes as before.
pair_gate_rule_in_words: In acquireSession the pair is requested on a probe after the submission whenever no DISCRIMINATING pair has yet run (record.probe_pair is absent or its discriminating is not true); a token-less first probe (pair not sent, discriminating false) therefore no longer forecloses a later probe whose jar holds an aws-waf-token, and once one pair with discriminating true has run no further pair is requested. probe_pair.discriminating keeps its meaning: true only for a pair that ran with a token.
